incoming.name: First Transcontinental Railroad
incoming.excerpt: The route followed the main trails used for the opening of the West pioneered by the Oregon, Mormon, California Trails and the Pony Express.

outgoing.name: Irrigation
outgoing.excerpt: An irrigation system was designed and the land flooded before plowing, with the system providing supplemental moisture during the year.

outgoing.name: Mexico
outgoing.excerpt: At the shore of the Great Salt Lake, then in Mexican territory, they finally settled down.
